title: Notebook Pairing
description: Connect notebooks through a Cloudflare Durable Object service.

serviceUrl.title: Pairing service URL
serviceUrl.description: HTTPS base URL of the deployed Cloudflare Worker.

showAdminLink.title: Show the admin dashboard link
showAdminLink.description: Adds a link to the pairing service's admin dashboard in the Notebook Pairing sidebar. Off by default because the sidebar is visible to everyone, and the dashboard is only reachable by whoever Cloudflare Access admits.
